title: Ordered coordinate and restriction models for scalar Koszul towers
statement: On a small ringed site, use the actual Koszul systems of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. Index the ordered tensor basis by functions e : Fin r → Bool and let degree(e) count its true values. The basis map is the ordered total-tensor inclusion of the degree-zero/one basis maps of each positive factor; for the empty list it is the sole degree-zero basis map. Dual evaluation on this vector, zero outside its negative degree, defines dualCoordinate. The universal coproduct descendent of tensor with this evaluation followed by the right unit is coordinate : T_O(N)_m^n → N^(n+degree(e)). For a ring-sheaf map φ, define imageSections pointwise, restriction on modules, complexes and inverse towers, and the canonical ordinary-limit comparison. These are the existing constructions moved from the scalar tower comparison without changing any object or map.

source.place: Tag 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul), finite free Koszul model; derived-limit restriction is Tag 0A07 (sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim), specialized to the identity topos with flat structural ring map. The strict tower, evaluation and unit normalization are made explicit.
